recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as the FHIR-5584 decision. No further core source work is needed unless the work group wants separate editorial cleanup of generated diagrams or historical/out-of-build model artifacts, which should not be hand-edited for this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-5584 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core documents. It reported that the documents page defined a $mailbox operation while the REST page also defined a /Mailbox endpoint, and asked to remove one of the overlapping mailbox constructs. The final Jira resolution says both were removed.
initial_application: No git commit was found that explicitly names FHIR-5584. The historical application appears in the same mailbox cleanup family: git-svn mirror commit 8b801ae887a7ed1c4e58cb57c30a8379b50cf157, titled "#7976, #6343 - rework operations and messages", removed the [baseurl]/$mailbox document-submission row from source/documents.html and replaced the main messaging mailbox section with $process-message. Older source/http.html history shows the overlapping /Mailbox message and document rows that motivated the issue.
additional_context: FHIR-6343 was Published as Persuasive with Modification and directly requested removal of the DSTU1 /Mailbox endpoint in favor of the operations framework. It cites svn revision 5657, matching the 8b801ae887a7ed1c4e58cb57c30a8379b50cf157 source application. FHIR-7976 was applied in the same svn revision for asynchronous message responses using $process-message. The combined branch already contains Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-6343 as commit 7c13c339718d8101a7a8891eae7c2dad54cdfa67, which removed surviving current-source mailbox wording from active REST, CapabilityStatement, use-case, and MessageHeader operation text.
reconciliation: No source change was made for FHIR-5584 because current source already has no active mailbox endpoint or $mailbox document operation. The documents page lists Bundle, Composition, Binary, and whole-system transaction handling for documents and points to operations for any additional document handling; the REST overview links message processing to $process-message rather than mailbox; and the CapabilityStatement implementation URL definition no longer describes mailbox interfaces.

related_jiras.note: Later Published mailbox-removal issue whose svn-r5657 application and 2026 AutoFHIR commit removed the active /Mailbox and stale mailbox guidance relevant to FHIR-5584.
Applied in the same svn-r5657 commit and explains the $process-message response-url model that replaced mailbox response handling.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue reporting overlapping $mailbox and /Mailbox constructs on documents and REST pages, with resolution 'Both removed now'.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent that the current specification should not retain either mailbox construct as active guidance.

evidence_items.summary: The svn-r5657 mirror commit titled '#7976, #6343 - rework operations and messages' removed the documents $mailbox row and replaced messaging mailbox text with $process-message.
evidence_items.learned: The mailbox cleanup was historically applied through the related mailbox/process-message change family, even though the commit did not name FHIR-5584.

evidence_items.summary: Current documents guidance lists Bundle, Composition, Binary, and whole-system transaction handling without mailbox; the REST overview links message processing to $process-message.
evidence_items.learned: The two overlapping constructs reported by FHIR-5584 are absent from current reader-facing source.

evidence_items.summary: CapabilityStatement implementation URL now describes REST interfaces including operations and document end-points, not mailbox interfaces, and CapabilityStatement is active in fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: Adjacent active conformance source is consistent with the mailbox-removal decision.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-6343 explicitly removed /Mailbox in favor of operations and cites svn revision 5657; FHIR-7976 was applied in the same revision for $process-message response handling; combined commit 7c13c339718d8101a7a8891eae7c2dad54cdfa67 already removed stale mailbox source references.
evidence_items.learned: Related final decisions account for the mailbox removal and explain why FHIR-5584 now needs only an audit commit.
